verdict.rationale: Teller is a bank-data and payments API, so batch or bulk endpoints are a fair thing to ask about, but the evidence pack documents no bulk or batch operation capability. Paginated transaction listing and the identity endpoint returning all granted accounts are ordinary list reads, not bulk operations. The community CSV export script is a user-built workaround, so neither earns credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
